trade_thesis: XAUUSD staged an explosive impulse from 3655 to an intraday high of 3682.3, but the latest 15m candle closed with an 8.1-point upper rejection wick at 3674.2 on declining volume (1,827 vs 3,486 prior). Entering long at this juncture represents chasing near local peak resistance with an unfavorable risk-reward profile (requiring an SL below 3655, risking over 30% of the account). Counter-trend shorting is equally hazardous given the strong underlying directional momentum. The optimal institutional strategy is to WAIT for a clean pullback and liquidity retest of the 3664-3668 support zone before committing fresh capital.
